vertex animation scalar or active keyword

commonRuntimeRequirements: positively proven original world-static renderer scope; material family alone is insufficient
retain original mesh, enabled/forceRenderingOff state, layer and all native controllers/callbacks
exclude actors, skinned geometry, animated/interactable subtrees, UI, video, water, particles, projectors and mod/clone assets
retain original per-renderer and per-slot MPBs; dynamic overrides use the exact native channel or veto
global fade, occlusion map, dimming and native fade choreography keep updating
floor never-fade only after native floor identity AND floor-plane proof
native source shader/material changes invalidate the lease immediately
restore owned originals on option-off, unload, clone construction, source mutation or failed proof
game source updates require recensus; shader/property names do not prove future program equivalence
exclusions: All material families absent from supportedFamilies remain native, including both Prop families, characters/foliage, animated/panning, unseen terrain, transparent/decal/VFX/particle, UI/font/video/water/world-map shader families. catalog.json lists every actual family and each overlapping feature-veto count; material-index.jsonl lists every excluded material individually.

limits: Offline audit coverage and native equation requirements are not a claim of scene coverage, live ownership correctness, headset appearance or frame-rate improvement. Root compressed-program differences are recorded, never silently treated as equal.
